rv.q: What hits home most forcefully in Raggett’s production, performed without interval for added intensity, is a clash of values, the orthodox reacting against the untamed, the forces of order punishing the violators.

Sure they’re ambitious, ruthless and homophobic, but their overarching aim is to stabilise their carefully constructed world has been thrown out of kilter by this upstart. Everyone is aggressive in this hyper-masculine court with two exceptions.
